wages.text: Soria voted for AB 1228, which established a minimum wage and employment standards for fast-food workers.

sentencing.text: Soria voted against advancing SB 94, which would have allowed certain people serving life without parole for pre-1990 murders to seek resentencing.
sentencing.quote: Do pass as amended. Ayes Bryan, Wendy Carrillo, Mike Fong, Hart, Holden, Lowenthal, Papan, Pellerin, Weber, Wilson Noes Megan Dahle, Dixon, Mathis, Sanchez, Soria

abortion.text: Soria voted for SB 385, which expanded training for physician assistants and allowed them to perform aspiration abortions without a supervising physician present.
abortion.quote: Bryan, Calderon, Wendy Carrillo, Mike Fong, Hart, Holden, Lowenthal, Papan, Pellerin, Soria, Weber, Wilson

gender.text: Soria voted for AB 1955, which bars schools from requiring staff to disclose a student's gender identity or expression without consent.
gender.quote: Rendon, Reyes, Luz Rivas, Rodriguez, Blanca Rubio, Santiago, Schiavo, Soria, Ting, Valencia, Villapudua, Ward, Weber, Wicks, Wilson, Wood, Zbur, Robert Rivas

cannabis.text: Soria voted for AB 374, which would have expanded regulated activities permitted at licensed cannabis-consumption businesses.

voting.text: Soria voted for SB 1174, which prohibited local governments from requiring identification to vote or submit a ballot.
